blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines – Marvin Villar captured the coveted “Bowler of the Month” title with Sugbuanon Bowlers United (SUGBU) after prevailing in a hard-fought monthly championship on Sunday at the SM Seaside Bowling and Leisure Center.
